description: This script provides functions for checking and performing firmware upgrades specific to certain hardware platforms, including Huawei HG253S V2 and Netgear DGND3700 V2. It contains conditional logic to decide whether to perform a NAND upgrade or a default upgrade based on the board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to validate the firmware image, currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Function to perform the firmware upgrade, selects upgrade method based on board name.
